51531745.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to CM5 sensor chip immobilized human HSP90alpha assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.SPR Analysis: The in vitro binding affinity assay between HSP90α and tested compounds was evaluated using a Biacore T200 SPR instrument (SPR, Biacore T200, GE Healthcare, Chicago, IL, USA). Pipelines and chips were prefused with phosphate buffered saline (PBS) (pH 7.4) running buffer, and then, human HSP90α was immobilized on a CMS sensor chip. Analysis was performed at a flow rate of 30 μL/min at 25 °C with the injection of incremental concentrations of DMSO dissolved in buffer solution (final concentration of DMSO is 1%). The binding and dissociation duration was recorded as response unit values for 120 and 300 s in succession, respectively. Data were finally analyzed using Biacore evaluation software by curve fitting using the 1:1 binding model.
